name: task-management
description: Takes over Claude Code's task system. Native task calls, approved plans, decisions, and commits are mirrored into a git-tracked markdown store at .bytedesk/task-management/ — epics, tasks, ADRs, acceptance criteria, evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Durable, git-tracked task board that takes over Claude Code's ephemeral task state.
interface.longDescription: Mirrors native task calls, approved plans, decisions, and commits into .bytedesk/task-management/ as markdown — epics, tasks, ADRs, acceptance criteria, evidence, and an append-only event log. Gates enforce an active epic, WIP limits, acceptance criteria, and clean session exits, with a one-shot override and a global kill switch.
defaultPrompt: Show the task board — what's in progress, blocked, and next.
Open an epic for this work and break it into tasks with acceptance criteria.
Write an ADR for the decision we just made.
Hand off this task to another agent with full context.
Groom the backlog: close zombies, merge duplicates, unstick false blocks.
